content:
BUILT CoLAB co-organizes, together with the SECClasS project team and the Technical Committee for National BIM Standardization (CT197) the event “Classification System for Construction in Portugal – current state and future work”, which takes place online on October 06, at 16h30.

This event will present the work that is being done and aims to mobilize the technical community for its continuation and completion.

Participation is free, but registration is required here.

Program:

16h30 – Opening and Reception. 16h35 – Presentation of CT197 and the Classification Task Group. 16h45 – SECCLasS project and EEA Grants. 16h55 – National Classification System: why, what for, how. 17h10 – SECClasS : current state and future work . 17h25 – Discussion and Clarifications. 17h30 – Closing

SECClasS (Sustainability Enhanced Construction Classification System) is an EEA Grants funded project that aims to facilitate Circular Economy in Construction by introducing a Sustainability-optimized Building Information Classification System.
